statements.t: “Ecovyst delivered another strong quarter, with third quarter 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of $61 million, up over 6% compared to the year-ago quarter, and above the high end of our guidance range,” said Kurt J.
Calabrian’s third quarter performance was consistent with our investment thesis, integration is underway, and we remain on track to capture anticipated synergies,” added Bitting.
“Given current refining economics, we anticipate high refinery utilization through year-end and we expect demand across our portfolio to remain healthy for the rest of the year.

We are again raising our full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $208 million to $212 million, reflecting strong momentum through the first nine months of the year and the shift of a turnaround from the fourth quarter into early 2027,” Bitting said.
We repurchased $2.7 million of our common stock in the third quarter and intend to repurchase up to a total of $20 million in the second half of 2026,” Bitting added.
For the remainder of 2026, we expect demand for regenerated and virgin sulfuric acid to remain positive.
We believe that high refinery utilization and strong alkylate demand will continue to support sales of regenerated sulfuric acid.
For virgin sulfuric acid, we expect ongoing growth in demand for copper mining applications will continue to benefit sales.
For sales of sulfur dioxide in our Calabrian business, we expect that high operating rates for Canadian gold mines will continue in the fourth quarter.
